title: The water slide
content: The Mall in my dream is luxury expensive, the lights are dim. There’s a little boutique that I love to window shop, but I never go in. They sell dresses and hats. I have a blonde friend, which I can’t see her face who works in the furniture store. She talks a lot, and we tend to go back and forth. When going down the escalator, there’s never anyone there. The security guard outside is a dick sometimes, but he does make sure that I get out of the gate safely. It’s always dark when I leave. There is a huge fountain out front. My mall is usually dead, could be because they’re expensive, or because I literally have no friends besides people who are desperate for attention. I do go to this cool dollar tree looking Walmart, and that’s always filled with cool people, it’s next to a white gas station that has an arcade and movie theater. The theatre is actually kind of creepy, quiet and quite large with a lot of handicap room.
